description: This file defines the Response interface which declares methods for handling LoggerData objects, retrieving data sets, data values, and timestamps within the ECU communication query context.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: An interface declaring methods for managing ECU response data and timestamps.

methods.name: setDataValue
methods.description: Sets a data value for a given LoggerData instance.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a set of LoggerData objects available in the response.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific LoggerData.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp associated with the response.
